column3: Close to the Hebrew; “sacrifices of strife” is rendered “feasting with strife.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a lip of wickedness” is rendered “false lips,” and “deception” “A liar.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “fathers” is rendered “their father.”
Close to the Hebrew; הַשֹּׁחַד (“the bribe”) is rendered “A present.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a rebuke goes deeper into one who understands” is rendered “Rebuke is more effective for a wise man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “abandon [it]” is rendered “stop contention.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who makes his entrance high” is rendered “he who exalts his gate.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּסִיל (“a fool,” kesil) is rendered “a scoffer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “makes good healing” is rendered “does good, like medicine.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from the bosom” is rendered “behind the back.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to strike nobles is against uprightness” is rendered “Nor to strike princes for their uprightness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “cool of spirit” (written “precious of spirit”) is rendered “is of a calm spirit.”
